book.name: Luqaasa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Luqaasi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Asas Dhuphe Gidanaappe Naageteth
Yesusi bana kaallizayta, «Asa dhuphidi nagaran yeggiza miishshi yontta aggenna; gido attiin yaana dhuphezas gaaso gidizaades aayye ana!
He addezi ha guuththatappe issaas dhuphe gidanaappe woxa shuchchi iza qoodhen qashettiin abba giddo izi yegettizaakko izas lo7o gidana.
Hessa gishshas intte hu7es naagettite. ‹Ne ishay nena qohikko hanqetta; izi ba mooro eridi simmiko maara.›
Issi gallassan laappunto zaari zaari qohidi laappuntokka zaari zaari, ‹Maara› giikko maara» gides.
Hawaaretikka, «Godoo! Nuus ammano gujja» gida.
Godaykka, «Gaashe ayfe lagge ammanoy inttes diikko hayssa, ‹Eththaa dhoqalletta baada abban gela toketta› intte giikko izi inttes azazettana» gides.

Qasseka Yesusi, «Intte giddofe issi asas goshshanchchay woykko dors heemmiza ashkaray diikko izi goshshasoppe simmishin, ‹Taas maana kawo giigsa; ta maada uyana gakkanaas gixettada taas ooththa; hessafe guye maandasanne uyandassa› gees attiin ha7i quma maana haa aadhdha gizee?
Histtiko he ashkaraa goday izi iza azazo polida gishshas iza galati erizee?
Hessa gishshas inttenikka intte azazettidayssa wursi polida wode, ‹Nuni go7ay baynda oosanchchata nuus ooththanaas bessizayssa poli ooththidos› gite» gides.
Yesusi Inchchirachcha Hargefe Paththida Tammu Asata
Hessafe guye Yesusi Yerusalaame bishe Samaariyaranne Galila achchara aadhdhides.
Issi guta gelida wode inchchirachcha hargiza tammu asati iza demmida. Isttika haahon eqqidi
ba qaala dhoqqu histtidi, «Yesusaa! Godoo! Nuus mishettarkkii!» gida.
Izikka istta be7idi, «Biite! Inttena qeesetas bessite» gides; isttika buro bishe oge bolla paxida.
Isttafe issoy ba paxidayssa be7idi ba qaala dhoqqu histtidi Xoossaa bonchchishe simmides.
Izaadeyka Yesusa toho bolla kundidi galatides; izikka Samaariya biitta asa.
Yesusikka addeza, «Paxidayti tammu as deettennee? Histtiin uddufunati awa bidoo?
Hayssa dumma dere addezappe attiin Xoossa galatizay baa guussee?» giidi oychchides.
Addezakka zaaridi «Dendada ba! Nena ne ammanoy paththides» gides.
Xoossa Kawoteththa Yuussa Gishshas
«Xoossa Kawoteththi ayde yaanee?» giidi Farsaaweti Yesusa oychchida wode Yesusi, «Xoossa kawoteththi beettiza malatatan yuukku.
Asay Xoossa kawoteththi haan dawus woykko heen dawus gaanaas dandayettenna; Xoossa kawoteththi intte giddon dawus» giidi zaarides.
Bana kaallizaytaska, «Asa Naa gallassatappe issi gallassayo beyanaas intte amottana wodey yaana; gido attiin intte beyekketa.
Asay inttes, ‹Haan dawus› woykko, ‹Heen dawus› gaana shin intte istta kaallidi boopite.
Gaasoykka wolqqanththi wolqqamidi ha gaxappe he gaxa gakkanaas poo7isiza mala Asa Nay yiza gallas iza mala hanana.
Gido attiin hayssi wuri hananaappe koyro Asa Nay daro meto ekkanaassinne hayssa ha yeletaan kadhettanaas bessees.
«Nohe wode hanidayssa mala Asa Naa wodenkka hessaththo hanana.
Nohey markaben gelana gallas gakkanaas asay mishininne uyishin, ekkishininne gelishin dhayssiza haaththi yiidi wursika dhayssides.
«Looxe wodekka iza mala hanides; asay meessinne uyees; bayzeessinne shammees; tokkizaaz tokkees; keeththika keexxees.
Gido attiin Looxey Sodoomeppe kezida gallas shuchchinne mith qorontta diine tamay saloppe bukkidi ubbaa dhayssides.
«Asa Nay qoncciza gallas hessaththo hanana.
He wode ba keeththa bolla dizaadey oonikka keeththa giddon diza miish ekkana giidi duge wodhdhofo; hessaththoka goshsha soon diza asi guye soo simmofo.
Looxe machcho qopite.
Ba de7o gam7isana koyzay wuri dhayssana; ba shempo aaththi immizaadey gam7isana.
Ta inttes gizay he wode omars nam7u asi issi hiixan ichchana; issoy ekettana; issoy attana.
Nam7u maccassati issife gaaccishin issineya ekettana; hankkoora attana.
Nam7u asi issife goshshason daana; issoy ekettana; issoy attana.
«Isttika zaaridi, ‹Godoo! Istti awa ekettanee?› gida; izikka ahay dizason ankkoti shiiqana» gides.

footnotes.text: Issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafatan taybo 36 bolla diza qofaa gujjeettes; qofazikka Mato 24:40 dizayssa misatees.
